sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 早在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会里当DJ时，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去上班，把DJ台变成一个摆满50年历史精美艺术品的生动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在即可在您喜爱的播客平台上收听来自奥彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》的我，是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Over the past few months, attacks by Houthi militants on global trade and the Western military, which once seemed like a dangerous sideshow to the war in Gaza,
sentences.zh: 在过去的几个月里，胡塞武装对全球贸易和西方军队的袭击——曾经在加沙战争中看起来只是一场危险的插曲——

sentences.en: have become a full-blown crisis.
sentences.zh: 已经演变成了一场全面的危机。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Gulf Bureau Chief Vivian Niran, on what the Houthis really want.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事、海湾分社社长薇薇安·尼兰将为您讲述胡塞武装的真正诉求。

sentences.en: Thursday, January 18.
sentences.zh: 1月18日，星期四。

sentences.en: There's a marked escalation of tensions along one of the world's busiest shipping routes.
sentences.zh: 世界最繁忙航线之一的紧张局势明显升级。

sentences.en: Houthi militants claimed responsibility for yet another attack on a container ship.
sentences.zh: 胡塞武装宣称对又一次针对集装箱船的袭击负责。

sentences.en: The latest target of Yemen's Houthis, Norwegian tanker Strinda, struck by a missile.
sentences.zh: 也门胡塞武装的最新目标是一艘遭到导弹袭击的挪威油轮“斯特兰达”号。

sentences.en: A U.S.
sentences.zh: 一艘美国

sentences.en: warship shot down 14 drones fired by suspected Houthi rebels in Yemen.
sentences.zh: 军舰击落了也门疑似胡塞反政府武装发射的14架无人机。

sentences.en: The escalation of attacks have encouraged a series of shipping companies to announce they would suspend their movements through the Red Sea.
sentences.zh: 袭击的升级促使一系列航运公司宣布暂停其在红海的航行。

sentences.en: A United States official tells CNN the U.S.
sentences.zh: 一名美国官员告诉美国有线电视新闻网，美军

sentences.en: military has carried out strikes on multiple Houthi targets in Yemen.
sentences.zh: 已对也门境内的多个胡塞武装目标实施了打击。

sentences.en: This war could be escalating big time.
sentences.zh: 这场战争可能会大幅升级。

sentences.en: The Pentagon confirms it has carried out more strikes against the Yemen-based Houthi rebels.
sentences.zh: 五角大楼证实，它对也门境内的胡塞武装发动了更多打击。

sentences.en: The third assault on the group in recent days.
sentences.zh: 这是几天内对该组织的第三次袭击。

sentences.en: The Houthi leaders said this aggression will not go unanswered, threatening to keep on attacking those ships that are passing through the Red Sea.
sentences.zh: 胡塞武装领导人表示，这种侵略不会没有回应，并威胁要继续袭击那些通过红海的船只。

sentences.en: President Biden saying he will not hesitate to act further if that continues.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统表示，如果这种情况继续下去，他将毫不犹豫地采取进一步行动。

sentences.en: Vivian, over the past few weeks, as militants in Yemen have carried out this really unusual military campaign against commercial ships in the Red Sea
sentences.zh: 薇薇安，在过去几周里，随着也门武装分子在红海对商船展开了这场非常罕见的军事行动，

sentences.en: and have basically crippled this trade route and triggered a very significant military response from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 并且基本瘫痪了这条贸易路线，引发了美国及其盟友非常强烈的军事反应，

sentences.en: and its allies, the question I think all of us have had with increasing urgency is what exactly has motivated these militants, the Houthis, to do this?
sentences.zh: 我想我们所有人越来越迫切地想知道的一个问题是，究竟是什么驱使这些武装分子——胡塞武装——做出这样的举动？

sentences.en: What do they want?
sentences.zh: 他们到底想要什么？

sentences.en: And how do these attacks in the Red Sea serve that cause?
sentences.zh: 红海的这些袭击又是如何服务于这一目标的？

sentences.en: Well, the Houthis' stated motivation has, from the start, been all about, you know, the Palestinians and Gaza and sort of forcing Israel to end its siege on Gaza.
sentences.zh: 嗯，从一开始，胡塞武装声称的动机就全都是关于，你知道的，巴勒斯坦人和加沙，以及某种程度上迫使以色列结束对加沙的围困。

sentences.en: They have for a very long time kind of centered opposition to Israel and hostility towards the United States and the Palestinian cause in their narrative and in their ideology.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，他们在自己的叙事和意识形态中，一直将反对以色列以及对美国的敌意和巴勒斯坦事业作为核心。

sentences.en: And they've really been kind of bringing that up.
sentences.zh: 他们确实一直在不断提起这些。

sentences.en: They've essentially been saying, you know, look at what Israel is doing to the Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 他们本质上一直在说，你看以色列对巴勒斯坦人做了什么。

sentences.en: No one is standing up for them.
sentences.zh: 没有人站出来支持他们。

sentences.en: None of the other Arab governments have really done anything.
sentences.zh: 其他阿拉伯政府没有一个真正采取了行动。

sentences.en: You know, they're not doing an oil embargo.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们没有实施石油禁运。

sentences.en: They're not going to war.
sentences.zh: 他们没有参战。

sentences.en: And that we essentially, and they represent themselves as, you know, the Yemeni government, we are the only state in the region that is doing anything about this,
sentences.zh: 而我们实质上——他们把自己塑造成也门政府的代表——我们是该地区唯一一个为此采取行动、

sentences.en: that is taking on Israel and the United States.
sentences.zh: 对抗以色列和美国的国家。

sentences.en: So the way that they're pushing all of this messaging out to the world is through this incredibly robust wartime propaganda.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们向世界传递所有这些信息的方式，就是通过这种极其强大的战时宣传。

sentences.en: They produce these music videos and songs and poeMs.
sentences.zh: 他们制作这些音乐视频、歌曲和诗歌。

sentences.en: You know, they're very active on social media, especially on X and TikTok.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们在社交媒体上非常活跃，特别是在X和TikTok上。

sentences.en: What exactly do these social media messages that they're putting out say?
sentences.zh: 他们发布的这些社交媒体信息究竟说了些什么？

sentences.en: They've released really catchy songs in Arabic.
sentences.zh: 他们发布了非常洗脑的阿拉伯语歌曲。

sentences.en: They kind of say things like, oh, you know, we're Yemeni, but our blood is Palestinian.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上会说，哦，你知道，我们是也门人，但我们的血是巴勒斯坦的。

sentences.en: They have done things like put up, you know, Twitter polls, essentially saying, you know, who are you on the side of?
sentences.zh: 他们做过的事情包括发布推特投票，基本上就是问，你知道的，你站在哪一边？

sentences.en: Are you on the side of genocide in America?
sentences.zh: 你是站在美国的种族灭绝这一边？

sentences.en: Or are you on the side of, you know, the brave Yemenis fighting genocide and standing up for justice, essentially?
sentences.zh: 还是站在勇敢的也门人打击种族灭绝、伸张正义这一边？

sentences.en: And that's a Twitter poll that they put out in English, kind of just trying to sort of speak to a different audience.
sentences.zh: 这是他们在英文里发起的一项推特投票，基本上只是为了尝试与不同的受众对话。

sentences.en: So that has become, again, a very important tool for them.
sentences.zh: 所以，这再次成为了他们一个非常重要的工具。

sentences.en: So what the Houthis say they want and what's captured in these propaganda videos that you just described
sentences.zh: 那么，胡塞武装声称他们想要什么，以及在你刚刚描述的这些宣传视频中所捕捉到的内容，

sentences.en: is to use these attacks to pressure Israel and Israel's allies, primarily the U.S., into ending Israel's military operation and Gaza.
sentences.zh: 就是利用这些袭击来施压以色列和以色列的盟友（主要是美国），迫使以色列结束在加沙的军事行动。

sentences.en: That's what they claim this is all about.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们宣称这一切的意义所在。

sentences.en: Yes, that's exactly what they say.
sentences.zh: 是的，这正是他们所说的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So that's what the Houthis want everyone to see as their animating cause.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是胡塞武装希望每个人都看到的他们行动的起因。

sentences.en: Is that, based on your reporting, based on your long-term understanding of the Houthis, is it that straightforward?
sentences.zh: 根据你的报道，根据你对胡塞武装的长期理解，事情真的这么简单吗？

sentences.en: Is that the reality of what is really motivating them?
sentences.zh: 这真的是真正激励他们的现实吗？

sentences.en: No, I think their behavior and their motivations are much more complicated than that.
sentences.zh: 不，我认为他们的行为和动机要比这复杂得多。

sentences.en: I mean, the Houthis ultimately want relevance.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，胡塞武装归根结底是想要获得存在感。

sentences.en: They want power.
sentences.zh: 他们想要权力。

sentences.en: They have a lot of domestic aiMs.
sentences.zh: 他们有许多国内目标。

sentences.en: And in so many ways, the war in Gaza has really been just this huge gift from the sky for them.
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，加沙战争对他们来说真的就像是从天而降的巨大礼物。

sentences.en: It enables them to achieve so many of their own aiMs.
sentences.zh: 这使他们能够实现他们自己的许多目标。

sentences.en: I mean, I can't even describe to you how strange it is as somebody who's covered the Houthis for many years,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，作为一个报道了胡塞武装多年的人，我甚至无法形容这是多么奇怪，

sentences.en: and they were this really just little-known group, to see how prominent they are and how much people who really know almost nothing about Yemen
sentences.zh: 他们曾经只是一个默默无闻的群体，而现在看到他们是如此显赫，看到那些对也门几乎一无所知的人

sentences.en: now talk about them and know who they are all over the world.
sentences.zh: 现在都在谈论他们，全世界都知道他们是谁。

sentences.en: Well, tell us that story of who the Houthis are, where they come from, and how the operation that they are now conducting
sentences.zh: 那么，给我们讲讲这个故事：胡塞武装是谁，他们从哪里来，以及他们现在正在进行的行动——

sentences.en: that has really kind of menaced the Red Sea and much of the West and its economy, how it achieves its real goals.
sentences.zh: 那个确实威胁了红海以及大部分西方国家及其经济的行动——是如何实现其真正目标的。

sentences.en: You know, it's funny.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这很有趣。

sentences.en: I actually went back into the Old Times articles to see, like, if we'd written anything about the early history of the Houthis,
sentences.zh: 我实际上翻看了《纽约时报》的旧文章，想看看我们是否写过任何关于胡塞武装早期历史的文章，

sentences.en: and we had, like, almost nothing on them before even the mid-2000s, which was interesting to me.
sentences.zh: 结果发现，在2000年中期之前，我们几乎没有任何关于他们的报道，这让我觉得很有意思。

sentences.en: Essentially, the Houthis' history as a movement dates back to the 1990s.
sentences.zh: 从本质上讲，胡塞武装作为一个运动的历史可以追溯到20世纪90年代。

sentences.en: They take their name from their tribe, which is this extended clan whose home territory is in the mountains of northern Yemen, near the border with Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 他们的名字取自他们的部落，这是一个大家族，其家乡领地位于也门北部山区，靠近沙特阿拉伯边境。

sentences.en: And they follow a subsect of Shia Islam and say that they're descendants of the Prophet Muhammad.
sentences.zh: 他们信仰什叶派伊斯兰教的一个分支，并自称是先知穆罕默德的后代。

sentences.en: So when they began their movement, they were really sort of a cultural and religious revivalist group that later became quite political.
sentences.zh: 因此，当他们发起这场运动时，他们实际上更像是一个文化和宗教复兴主义组织，后来变得相当政治化。

sentences.en: They began to adopt this slogan that essentially goes, death to America, death to Israel, a curse upon the Jews.
sentences.zh: 他们开始采用这样一个口号，大意是：美国去死，以色列去死，诅咒犹太人。

sentences.en: So their core ideology is really anti-American, anti-Zionist, and anti-Semitic.
sentences.zh: 所以他们的核心意识形态确实是反美、反犹太复国主义和反犹太主义的。

sentences.en: But when it comes to their political goals in Yemen at that time, they were really interested in fighting the Yemeni government.
sentences.zh: 但当谈到他们当时在也门的政治目标时，他们真正感兴趣的是与也门政府战斗。

sentences.en: They very much portrayed themselves as fighting against corruption and fighting against foreign influence.
sentences.zh: 他们极力把自己塑造成反腐败和反对外国影响的斗士。

sentences.en: And their rise to prominence really coincided with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们崛起并崭露头角，实际上与美国在2003年

sentences.en: invasion of Iraq in 2003.
sentences.zh: 入侵伊拉克巧合。

sentences.en: And they really absorbed that invasion, which was incredibly unpopular, you know, throughout the Middle East and among Arab countries.
sentences.zh: 他们对那场入侵深有感触，那场入侵在整个中东和阿拉伯国家极不受欢迎。

sentences.en: They sort of saw this as an incredibly destabilizing military incursion into their region that they did not support.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这是一次对他们所在的地区进行的不稳定的、他们不支持的军事入侵。

sentences.en: And the Houthis really seized on that and on sort of general rising anti-Americanism and incorporated that battling foreign influence really deep into their ideology.
sentences.zh: 胡塞武装紧紧抓住这一点，抓住了普遍高涨的反美情绪，并将这种对抗外国影响的理念深深融入了他们的意识形态中。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And of course, the war in Iraq was about as clear a case of a foreign power stepping into their neighborhood as you could possibly imagine.
sentences.zh: 当然，伊拉克战争可以说是外国势力干涉他们邻近地区最明显的例子了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And for them, you know, they really saw U.S.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，你知道的，他们确实也看到了美国

sentences.en: influence in their own country as well because the, you know, longtime Yemeni ruler who they were fighting against was this U.S.-allied autocrat.
sentences.zh: 对他们自己国家的影响，因为他们与之战斗的长期也门统治者是一个亲美的独裁者。

sentences.en: And he had been in power for more than 30 years, very repressive, very corrupt government, and very unpopular.
sentences.zh: 他已经掌权30多年，政府非常专制、非常腐败，也非常不得人心。

sentences.en: And they were for a long time fighting against him.
sentences.zh: 他们长期以来一直在与他战斗。

sentences.en: So Yemen is already in this really kind of destabilized moment around 2010 and 2011 when the Arab Spring arrives all over the region.
sentences.zh: 因此，当阿拉伯之春席卷整个地区时，也门在大约2010年和2011年已经处于这种动荡的时刻。

sentences.en: There are these sort of revolutions toppling strongmen.
sentences.zh: 当时发生了推翻强人的革命。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And one of the strongmen who gets toppled is Ali Abdullah Saleh, the Yemeni leader, in this sort of like fit of popular anger.
sentences.zh: 其中一个被推翻的强人就是也门领导人阿里·阿卜杜拉·萨利赫，在一股民众愤怒的情绪中倒台。

sentences.en: Now, what happened over the next couple of years was really chaotic.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几年里发生的事情非常混乱。

sentences.en: And eventually the Houthis saw an opportunity.
sentences.zh: 最终胡塞武装看到了机会。

sentences.en: And in 2014, they seized control of the Yemeni capital of Sana'a.
sentences.zh: 2014年，他们夺取了也门首都萨那的控制权。

sentences.en: And they sort of installed themselves as the alternative.
sentences.zh: 他们将自己确立为替代方案。

sentences.en: So now that this clan from the northern mountains of Yemen has taken over the capital and the institutions, I would imagine, of Yemen's government,
sentences.zh: 既然这个来自也门北部山区的家族已经占领了也门首都和政府机构，我想象，

sentences.en: what does the world make of that?
sentences.zh: 世界对此作何感想？

sentences.en: Well, it's something that pretty immediately made Saudi Arabia, Yemen's much larger neighbor to the north, very nervous and concerned.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这让也门北部的北方邻国沙特阿拉伯立即感到非常紧张和担忧。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: The Houthis are essentially a militia, right?
sentences.zh: 胡塞武装本质上是一个民兵组织，对吧？

sentences.en: They're this kind of religiously inspired militia.
sentences.zh: 他们是这种具有宗教色彩的民兵组织。

sentences.en: And that alone was enough to make Saudi Arabia nervous.
sentences.zh: 仅此一点就足以让沙特阿拉伯感到紧张。

sentences.en: They have this very long border with Yemen.
sentences.zh: 他们与也门有着非常长的边界。

sentences.en: They did not want a militia on the other side of the border.
sentences.zh: 他们不希望边境的另一边有一个民兵组织。

sentences.en: But perhaps equally as important to that is the fact that the Houthis had become aligned with Iran, which is Saudi Arabia's regional rival.
sentences.zh: 但可能同样重要的是，胡塞武装已经与沙特阿拉伯的地区对手伊朗结盟。

sentences.en: And Saudi Arabia was very worried about the idea of this Iran-influenced militia, potentially Iran-supported militia,
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯非常担心这个受伊朗影响的民兵组织——可能也是受伊朗支持的民兵组织——

sentences.en: taking over this large chunk of its southern border and what that would mean and the sense of being sort of crunched in by Iran-influenced proxies from different sides.
sentences.zh: 接管其南部边境的一大片地区意味着什么，以及那种被来自不同方向受伊朗影响的代理人左右夹击的感觉。

sentences.en: So basically in early 2015, Saudi Arabia gets together a coalition of Arab governments and the Saudi-led coalition starts a bombing campaign in Yemen.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上在2015年初，沙特阿拉伯集结了一个阿拉伯政府联盟，这个由沙特领导的联盟在也门开始了轰炸行动。

sentences.en: A direct strike in broad daylight.
sentences.zh: 白日青天之下的直接打击。

sentences.en: It's too graphic to show in full, but the bodies being pulled out belong to three-month-old Samuld and her three-year-old brother, Nabi.
sentences.zh: 画面太过惨烈无法完整展示，被拉出的尸体属于三个月大的萨穆尔德和她三岁的哥哥纳比。

sentences.en: A bombing campaign that much of the world eventually comes to see as really intensive, gruesome, and lethal.
sentences.zh: 这场轰炸行动最终被世界上许多人视为高度密集、骇人听闻且致命的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Residents say Saudi warplanes have dropped more than 100 bombs in civilian neighborhoods over the past few days.
sentences.zh: 居民称，在过去的几天里，沙特战机在平民区投下了100多枚炸弹。

sentences.en: Yemen was already one of the Arab world's poorest countries, and this war essentially pitched it into one of the world's worst humanitarian crises.
sentences.zh: 也门已经是阿拉伯世界最贫穷的国家之一，这场战争本质上把它推入了世界最严重的人道主义危机之一。

sentences.en: United Nations officials are warning that Yemen faces famine on a scale the world has not seen in decades.
sentences.zh: 联合国官员警告说，也门面临着几十年来世界未见的规模的饥荒。

sentences.en: They're talking of millions of victiMs.

sentences.en: I mean, we pretty immediately were speaking to Yemenis who were saying, you know, even in territories that are hostile towards the Houthis, were saying that, oh,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们几乎立刻就与也门人进行了交谈，他们说，你知道的，甚至在敌视胡塞武装的领土上，也有人说，哦，

sentences.en: it looks like the U.S.
sentences.zh: 看起来美国

sentences.en: just wants to attack them because they're defending the Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 只想攻击他们，因为他们在捍卫巴勒斯坦人。

sentences.en: So immediately that U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，美国这种试图剖析和界定事件的努力在整个也门立刻被视为徒劳。

sentences.en: effort to kind of parse this and frame it is seen as futile throughout Yemen.
sentences.zh: 试图剖析和界定事件。

sentences.en: Yeah, it definitely falls flat in Yemen and in the broader Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 是的，它在也门和更广泛的中东地区无疑反响平平。

sentences.en: And there is honestly such a high level of anti-Americanism across the region right now that it's very easy for the Houthis to spread this narrative and to gain popularity over it.
sentences.zh: 老实说，整个地区目前的反美情绪如此高涨，以至于胡塞武装很容易传播这种叙事并借此赢得人气。

sentences.en: Regardless of how these attacks are being discussed or framed, do the U.S.
sentences.zh: 无论这些袭击是如何被讨论或定性的，美国的

sentences.en: coalition airstrikes work at all?
sentences.zh: 联盟空袭到底有没有用？

sentences.en: Are they doing what the United States wants them to do, which is to weaken the Houthis' capacity to strike ships in the Red Sea
sentences.zh: 它们是否达到了美国想要的效果，即削弱胡塞武装打击红海船只的能力，

sentences.en: or in any way deter the Houthis from continuing to wage these attacks?
sentences.zh: 或者在任何程度上阻止胡塞武装继续发动这些袭击？

sentences.en: They certainly do not deter the Houthis, who pretty immediately have started to stage attacks again and have vowed that they're going to be staging even bigger attacks.
sentences.zh: 它们当然没有震慑住胡塞武装，胡塞武装几乎立刻又开始策划袭击，并誓言要发动更大规模的袭击。

sentences.en: And they've said now that they see not only targets tied to Israel as legitimate targets,
sentences.zh: 他们现在表示，不仅与以色列有关的目标是合法目标，

sentences.en: but any targets tied to American or British interests as legitimate targets for them to hit.
sentences.zh: 任何与美国或英国利益相关的目标对他们来说都是可以打击的合法目标。

sentences.en: So essentially, they are now widening the war.
sentences.zh: 因此，本质上，他们现在正在扩大战争。

sentences.en: They're saying that this is a world war that we are excited to enter into now and we're ready for it.
sentences.zh: 他们说这是一场我们很高兴加入的世界大战，我们已经准备好了。

sentences.en: Excited to enter.
sentences.zh: 很高兴加入。

sentences.en: That's how they're framing this.
sentences.zh: 他们就是这样看待这件事的。

sentences.en: Yeah, they are really, honestly, with pretty open delight.
sentences.zh: 是的，老实说，他们确实带着一种公开的喜悦。

sentences.en: I mean, there was a post today on social media from one of their politicians basically saying, and I'll quote him, we're not worried about this battle, nor do we care about it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，社交媒体上今天有一篇来自他们其中一位政客的帖子，基本上是说，我引用他的话，我们不担心这场战斗，也不在乎它。

sentences.en: The missiles and planes that we were bombed with during the past nine years are the same ones that America has today.
sentences.zh: 过去九年轰炸我们的导弹和飞机，就是美国今天拥有的那些。

sentences.en: America was conducting this war against us undercover, and today we will confront it directly.
sentences.zh: 美国过去一直在暗中对我们发动这场战争，今天我们要与它正面交锋。

sentences.en: It's a positive thing because America is what brought destruction, siege, and poverty to our country.
sentences.zh: 这是一件积极的事情，因为美国给我们国家带来了毁灭、围困和贫困。

sentences.en: So instead of doing anything to contain the Houthis' aggression, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，美国的回应不仅没有采取任何措施遏制胡塞武装的侵略，反而正如许多人可能担心的那样，

sentences.en: response, as perhaps many feared,
sentences.zh: 正如许多人所担忧的，

sentences.en: risks, if not already is, expanding the thread of the Houthis.
sentences.zh: 有可能——如果还不是已经这样的话——扩大胡塞武装的威胁。

sentences.en: And any future attacks from the U.S., which the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国未来发动的任何袭击——美国声称它将采取的行动——也将产生同样的效果。

sentences.en: claims it will undertake, is going to do the same.
sentences.zh: 美国声称它将采取的行动。

sentences.en: It's going to make things worse.
sentences.zh: 这只会让事情变得更糟。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: There does seem to be a real risk of further escalation at this moment.
sentences.zh: 目前局势进一步升级的风险确实存在。

sentences.en: It's not clear how this is going to quiet down.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚局势将如何平息。

sentences.en: Well, what are the options for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，如果武装冲突和报复被证明如此无效，美国还有什么选择？

sentences.en: if armed conflict and retaliation is proving to be so ineffective?
sentences.zh: 武装冲突和报复。

sentences.en: What is basically the way out of a dynamic in which responses from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 从根本上讲，有什么方法可以摆脱这样一种动态：美国及其盟友的反应正在助长胡塞武装的叙事，让胡塞武装在国内更受欢迎，并且永远不想停止这样做？

sentences.en: and its allies are feeding the Houthi narrative and making the Houthis more popular at home and less likely to ever want to stop doing this?
sentences.zh: 让胡塞武装在国内更受欢迎，更不可能想停止这样做？

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国。

sentences.en: definitely doesn't have a great option or menu of responses in terms of how it's going to address the Houthi threat.
sentences.zh: 在如何应对胡塞武装的威胁方面，美国显然没有一个很好的选择或应对方案。

sentences.en: However, one argument that we're hearing pretty consistently from regional American allies like Qatar and Oman, which is a neighbor of Yemen and knows Yemen very well,
sentences.zh: 然而，我们从卡塔尔和阿曼等地区美国盟友那里听到的一个相当一致的观点是——阿曼是也门邻国，对也门情况非常了解——

sentences.en: has been that the only way to address the threat posed by the Houthis is to resolve the underlying conflict that is inflaming tensions across the region.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，解决胡塞武装威胁的唯一方法，是解决加剧整个地区紧张局势的根本冲突。

sentences.en: And that, they say, is the war in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 而他们所说的根本冲突，就是加沙战争。

sentences.en: And their argument, essentially, is that it is the war in Gaza that is spreading all of these tensions, that is causing all of these different forms of escalation,
sentences.zh: 他们的观点基本上是，正是加沙战争在蔓延所有这些紧张局势，引发了所有这些不同形式的升级，

sentences.en: and that is giving the Houthis a pretext for their attacks.
sentences.zh: 并且为胡塞武装的袭击提供了借口。

sentences.en: And if you can resolve that underlying conflict, if you can reach a ceasefire, and you can defuse that, then you will ultimately defuse all of the other problems
sentences.zh: 如果你能解决那场根本冲突，如果你能达成停火并化解矛盾，那么你最终就能化解所有其他问题，

sentences.en: that are going on in the region right now.
sentences.zh: 也就是目前正在该地区发生的种种问题。

sentences.en: My guess is that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我猜美国

sentences.en: rejects that logic because it might feel to them like a reward for what the Houthis are up to.
sentences.zh: 拒绝这种逻辑，因为对他们来说，这可能感觉像是对胡塞武装行径的一种奖赏。

sentences.en: You know, we're going to call for a ceasefire.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们要呼吁停火。

sentences.en: We're going to push for an end to Israel's battle against Hamas just to stop the Houthis from attacking ships in the Red Sea.
sentences.zh: 我们要推动结束以色列针对哈马斯的战斗，仅仅为了阻止胡塞武装袭击红海船只。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, there's certainly a fear now in the region and beyond that the Houthis know that they have this power and that they're not going to simply stop using it, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，现在该地区乃至更广泛的地区确实有一种担忧，即胡塞武装知道他们拥有这种权力，并且他们不会轻易停止使用它，对吧？

sentences.en: They know now that they can essentially, you know, hold global trade hostage by attacking ships in the Red Sea, and it's difficult to imagine them never using that card again
sentences.zh: 他们现在知道，通过袭击红海船只，他们基本上可以挟持全球贸易，很难想象他们会放弃再次打出这张牌的可能，

sentences.en: if they know that they can play it.
sentences.zh: 如果他们知道自己能打这张牌的话。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And how should we think about that, Vivian?
sentences.zh: 薇薇安，我们该如何看待这一点？

sentences.en: I mean, the reality that in a very short time, the Houthis go from the clan that they were to essentially the governing power in Yemen to now a force that is not just willing,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，现实情况是，在很短的时间内，胡塞武装从最初的一个宗族，基本上变成了也门的统治力量，而现在又变成了一支不仅愿意、

sentences.en: but able to menace all of Western commerce in the Red Sea.
sentences.zh: 而且有能力威胁红海所有西方商业的军事力量。

sentences.en: I mean, it's really a remarkable rise.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这确实是一个惊人的崛起。

sentences.en: I mean, the Houthis were such an underdog, and I don't think any of us imagined that we would be in this position when somebody sitting in New York even knows who they are, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，胡塞武装曾处于极大的劣势，我想我们谁也没有想到我们会处于这样一种境地，当纽约的某个人甚至都知道他们是谁的时候，对吧？

sentences.en: They have just risen so quickly, and they've defeated so many enemies that were so much more powerful than them that they essentially see themselves as finally, you know,
sentences.zh: 他们崛起得太快了，击败了那么多比他们强大得多的敌人，以至于他们基本上认为自己终于、你知道的，

sentences.en: in the divine right path now.
sentences.zh: 走上了神圣的正义之路。

sentences.en: They see God is on their side.
sentences.zh: 他们认为上帝站在他们这一边。

sentences.en: You know, they have no fear partly because of that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，部分正因如此，他们毫无畏惧。

sentences.en: I mean, the Houthis have been very upfront that they are absolutely not afraid of getting dragged into a long and extended war with the United States,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，胡塞武装一直非常坦率地表示，他们绝对不怕被拖入与美国的长久消耗战中，

sentences.en: and they've explicitly brought up, you know, the precedents of Afghanistan and Vietnam and threatened that, you know, come on.
sentences.zh: 并且他们明确提出了阿富汗和越南的前车之鉴，威胁说，来吧。

sentences.en: Come and enter Yemen.
sentences.zh: 来进入也门。

sentences.en: Invade Yemen.
sentences.zh: 入侵也门。

sentences.en: We're ready for you, and you have no idea what is in for you, essentially.
sentences.zh: 我们已经准备好了，而你们根本不知道等待你们的是什么。

sentences.en: They're this guerrilla fighting force that has managed to withstand
sentences.zh: 他们就是这样一支游击作战力量，设法经受住了

sentences.en: much more powerful entities for years and years, and that has put them in this position where they really feel that they have nothing to lose.
sentences.zh: 强大得多的实体的多年考验，这让他们处于这样一种境地：他们真的觉得自己没什么可失去的。

sentences.en: Well, Vivian, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，薇薇安，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, the United States said that it would designate the Houthis as a terrorist organization in its latest and so far fruitless attempt to pressure the group
sentences.zh: 周三，美国表示将把胡塞武装列为恐怖组织，这是其最新也是迄今为止徒劳的尝试，旨在施压该组织

sentences.en: into ending its attacks in the Red Sea.
sentences.zh: 停止其在红海的袭击。

sentences.en: The Biden administration had removed the Houthis from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府曾在2021年将胡塞武装从美国的

sentences.en: terrorist in 2021, saying the decision would make it easier for humanitarian aid to reach the people of Yemen.
sentences.zh: 恐怖分子名单中除名，称此举将使人道主义援助更容易送达也门人民手中。

sentences.en: The latest designation would, among other things, block the Houthis' access to the global financial system and further isolate the group from Western institutions.
sentences.zh: 最新的列管除其他事项外，将阻止胡塞武装接触全球金融系统，并进一步将该组织与西方机构隔离开来。

sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 让·卡罗尔指控唐纳德·特朗普诽谤她的审判的法官警告特朗普，如果他继续发表陪审团能听到的言论，他可能会被逐出法庭。

sentences.en: And the next two Republican presidential debates scheduled for Thursday and Sunday night in New Hampshire have been canceled because just one qualified candidate,
sentences.zh: 原定于周四和周日晚间在新罕布什尔州举行的接下来的两场共和党总统初选辩论已被取消，因为只有一位符合资格的候选人、

sentences.zh: 特朗普拒绝参加任何初选辩论。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了许多自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时甚至令人惊心动魄的争斗之中。
